text.p: Mexican brokerage Abaco said Monday it has cut Mexican corn-flour giant Grupo Industrial Maseca SA de CV to sell from buy.

-- Ceiling on Mexican government corn-flour subsidies "have unfortunately cast a shadow of uncertainty over Maseca's immediate future, highly compromising the company's expansion plan and short-term growth in sales," analyst Marcela Martinez wrote in a report.
--Downgrade is from Abaco's highest rating to its lowest.
--"Therefore, for the time being and until this (subsidy) issue is resolved, we recommend sell," Abaco said.

--Maseca's 1996 report "was on line with our estimates" with year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter growth in sales, volumes, gross profit and operating profit, but gross and operating margins were down because of a shift to lower-margin bulk sales and higher corn prices.
--Financial income dropped 39.2 percent in 1996 compared to 1995 due to lower interest rates, which in turn led to a 54.6 percent reduction in net interest earned.
